draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.84, the 199th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 13th of 18 at TE. He went 143rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (199th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (91st percentile). College production: 447 receiving yards in 2021, 9th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders. 68 career games and 42 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: team target share 14.9% (85th percentile), receiving yards 560 (82nd percentile), season snap share 63.1% (80th percentile). Weak spots: drop rate 6.3% (24th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 560 receiving yards against a median of 179, above the norm.
